{"draft": "Revenue Grows in the Third Quarter as Earnings Ease

Rollins, Inc. reported third-quarter revenues of $1.1 billion, up 6.2% from a year earlier, with organic revenues rising 4.4%.

Operating income slipped 1.0% to $223 million, while operating margin narrowed to 20.5%, down 140 basis points from the prior year. Adjusted operating income came in at $231 million, for an adjusted operating margin of 21.2%.

Net income declined 3.4% to $158 million, while adjusted net income was $163 million. Adjusted EBITDA totaled $257 million, with an adjusted EBITDA margin of 23.5%.

Earnings per diluted share fell 2.9% to $0.33, while adjusted earnings per diluted share were $0.34.

Operating cash flow climbed 26.4% to $242 million, and free cash flow jumped 28.8% to $235 million.

During the quarter, the company spent $120 million on share repurchases and paid dividends totaling $87 million."}
